name: alexandria-mouseion
description: Explore ancient Alexandria and the Library: a source-led 3D reconstruction, readable texts, bilingual ambience and optional Afterlives scenes.

paragraphs: Explore the live city · Read the collection · MIT license

A source-led, freely walkable interpretation of an Alexandrian city district and the royal Library’s scholarly setting around 250 BCE. This is a possible Hellenistic city and Mouseion, not an excavated street plan or a recovered holdings catalogue.

The city connects a broad street, shops, market, cargo houses, working quays, courtyard homes and a royal court to the Mouseion. Inside are a peristyle court, book room, copying room, exedra, shared dining room, scholars’ chamber, garden and harbour terrace. All fourteen map destinations can be reached on foot. Separate city and Mouseion map views support direct travel. An optional eight-stop narrated library tour takes about four and a half minutes, with pause, replay, stop selection and transcripts.
